[Intro]
[Em]
He was a

[Verse 1]
[Em]hardheaded man He was
brutally handsome,
and she was terminally pretty
She held him up, and he
held her for ransom in the heart
Of the cold, cold
city He had a

[Pre-Chorus]
[A]nasty reputation as a
cruel dude They
[Em]said he was ruthless,
they said he was crude They had
[B]one thing in common, they were
good in bed She'd say,
[A7]"Faster, faster. The
lights are turnin' red."

[Chorus]
[Em]Life in the fast lane,
Surely makes you lose your mind
Life in the fast lane,
Huh

[Bridge]
[Em]
Are you with me so far?

[Verse 2]
[Em]Eager for action
and hot for the game The
coming attraction, the
drop of a name They knew
all the right people, they took
all the right pills They threw
outrageous parties, they paid
heavenly bills There were

[Pre-Chorus]
[A]lines on the mirror,
lines on her face She pre-
[Em]tended not to notice, she was
caught up in the race
[B]Out every evening, un-
til it was light He was
[A7]too tired to make it, she was
too tired to fight about it

[Chorus]
[Em]Life in the fast lane,
Surely makes you lose your mind
Life in the fast lane,
Huh
Life in the fast lane,
Everything all the time
Life in the fast lane, Huh

[Solo 1]
[B]
[D]
[B]
[A]

[Interlude]
[F#m7]

[Verse 3]
[Em]Blowin' and burnin',
blinded by thirst They
didn't see the stop sign, took a turn
for the worst She said,
"Listen, baby. You can
hear the engine ring. We've been
up and down this highway, haven't
seen a goddamn thing." He said,

[Pre-Chorus]
[A]"Call the doctor. I
think I'm gonna crash." "The
[Em]doctor says he's comin', but you
gotta pay in cash." They went
[B]rushin' down that freeway, messed a-
round and got lost
[A7]They didn't care, they were just
dyin' to get off And it was

[Chorus]
[Em]Life in the fast lane,
Surely makes you lose your mind
Life in the fast lane,
Huh
Life in the fast lane,
Everything all the time
